gnosh logs

  Print the end of the project's log, or follow it. With a session's ID (or
  the start of one), what that session printed as a run in the background
  (gnosh --bg, /background, /fork; gnosh agents lists them); --follow follows
  it until the run is done.

  Not built yet in this build of gnosh: typing it stops with a message that
  says so.

Usage
  gnosh logs [flags] [session]

Flags
  -f, --follow
      Keep printing as the log grows. (Not built yet.)
  -t, --tail <n>
      Print the last n lines: 1000 unless this is given. (Not built yet.)
  --cwd <dir>
      Work in this folder instead of the current one.
  -h, --help
      Show help: gnosh's, or after a command's name that command's.
